# Build Overview (widget 6)
Some changes in 0.5, [Ancestral Cry] and [Walking Calamity] no longer trigger [Fire Spell on Hit] and [Cast on Elemental Ailment], but fissures from [Molten Crash] still do! Check changelog, added [Titan] crit variant

Combine bear shapeshift with [Smith of Kitava]'s [Fire Spell on Hit] ([Living Bomb]) and [Cast on Elemental Ailment] (fire-infused [Comet]). Trigger these two and fissures with permanent* [Ancestral Cry] steps with the help of 100% increased glory gain. Sustain [Walking Calamity] and health via [Primal Hunger] rage/[Endurance] charge loop ( [Rageforged I] + [Jagged Ground I]), recovering 9% HP each time you take a step. Add in [Fury of the King] (Balrog talisman Unique) to truly fulfill the fantasy
* Requires that 2 buffs are maintained for 0-1 button gameplay. Explanation in How It Works
## Early Leveling (1 to 52)
- Please check out the Act 1-4 variants in the guide
- Venom (Quest reward): Stun threshold, Tattoo: 5% resistances, Tribal medicine: 30% Armour/EV/ES Pillar: 5% resistance (early)

# How it Plays (widget 7) — FAQ
- Weapon set passive points: need normal passive points available first; to apply max 24 weapon points each set you need 24 normal points available.
- Track Ancestral Cry (Ferocious Roar) glory: put Ancestral Cry on skill bar... IN PATCH 0.5 YOU HAVE TO SOCKET ANOTHER SEPERATE [Ancestral Cry] AND PUT THAT ON THE BAR. STILL ONLY PRESS [Ferocious Roar]
- Ancestral Cry deactivated when swap to human form (set 2): select for BOTH sets: uncheck set 1, select set 2, then check set 1.
- Ancestral Cry not getting glory in abyssal depths: bug; unsocket from Ferocious Roar and socket again.
- Dying to ignite: Before taking [Self Immolation], you need [One With Flame] or you will DIE! to your own ignite
- Can't socket X into X: must first socket skill gem into meta skill before related supports. e.g. Ancestral Cry must be in Ferocious Roar before Prolonged Duration II.
- Other questions: read guide fully; Discord.

# How it Works (widget 8)
(full text) This build focuses on maximising the potential of [Ancestral Cry]. It is a glory skill and requires 100 glory before it can be used. Glory ... [Ancestral Cry] requires that you ignite monsters to generate glory, higher rarity more glory. [Walking Calamity] gains glory whenever you gain rage over your maximum. It is mandatory to socket [Ancestral Cry] inside [Ferocious Roar] for it to work while in bear form, replacing Ferocious Roar's innate warcry effect, but buffing Ancestral Cry with increased AoE and damage.
[Fury of the King] has a unique modifier that passively generates glory even outside of combat, and with the help of 100% increased glory gain from [Smith's Masterwork] ([Kitavan Imprint]) and [Invigorating Grandeur] will generate 10 glory every 2 seconds (for each skill). Glory skills cannot gain glory while active -> downtime.
To minimise downtime, Ancestral Cry and Walking Calamity have a duration increased with nodes such as [Tides of Change], or modifiers on [Ruby] jewels. Ancestral Cry +70% duration per [Endurance] charge. 7 endurance charges -> over 2 minutes.
Bear form: passive generating 1 Endurance charge for every 15 rage you spend. Socket [Rageforged I] in [Walking Calamity]: every meteor tries to consume 10 rage. Walking Calamity generates 5 rage per second -> passively generates endurance charges. [Primal Hunger] keystone: every time we consume rage, grants it back over 4 seconds -> feedback loop.
Socket [Jagged Ground I] into [Ancestral Cry]: every step while Ancestral Cry active causes a small slam consuming an Endurance charge to create jagged ground. With passives [Guts] and [Flare], total 9% life recovered every time we consume an endurance charge, and tons of extra fire damage.
Step slam isn't enough to kill; use Smith of Kitava's [Fire Spell on Hit] and [Cast on Elemental Ailment]. Walking on top of fissures from [Molten Crash] procs Fire Spell on Hit socketed with [Living Bomb] for damage and fire infusions. Consume infusions with [Comet] in Cast on Elemental Ailment to convert large portion of its cold damage to fire ([Avatar of Fire] converts the rest). Scale ignite with [Fulmination] solely for more consistent Cast on Elemental Ailment.
Bosses: Ancestral Cry steps are considered a slam -> trigger fissures. Fury of the King has innate skill [Molten Crash] that creates fissures. Weapon swap 2-handed mace in set 2 to use [Forge Hammer] for even more fissures. When fissures explode from walking over them with Ancestral Cry active, they also activate Fire Spell on Hit AND Cast on Elemental Ailment. Extra damage buffs from [Savage Fury], broken armour via [Ancestral Warrior Totem] ([The Molten One's Gift]) and [Infernal Cry].

# Strengths / Weaknesses (widget 18)
STRENGTHS: Cataclysmic Fire EVERYWHERE; Not using [Rampage]; 0-1* button build; Kill stuff by walking; Insane recovery; 50%+ movespeed
WEAKNESSES: Buff management; Visual clarity

## Act 1 (24 equip) weapon stat priority: %inc phys / adds phys; adds elemental; +melee levels; attack speed. Armour/jewelry: MS boots; ele res; max life; %armour/+armour body; adds X damage to attacks, +melee levels. "Talisman in Set 1, buy from vendor or make a druid character to get one"
## Act 1 (25 gems) - Build rage with [Maul], use [Furious Slam] with 10+ rage. [Maul] to stand up for [Furious Slam]
- Place 2x [Shockwave Totem] after doing above combo on Jagged Ground from [Furious Slam], and fissure from [Fury of the Mountain]
- [Fury of the Mountain] replaces [Maul] for rage gen, so swap [Rage I] support to it!
- [Fury of the Mountain] fissures DO NOT STACK! Only one is needed under a boss
- [Savage Fury] for burst windows on bosses
## Act 1 (26 tree) Attribute travel nodes: mix int & str; focus str over int if required.

## Act 2 (28 equip) same priority + "Set 2 requires a high damage two-handed mace"
## Act 2 (29 gems) Single-target rotation: [Infernal Cry] before using [Volcanic Fissure]/[Forge Hammer]; [Ferocious Roar] then [Fury of the Mountain] once; place 1 or 2 [Shockwave Totem]; spam [Furious Slam]; [Savage Fury] if available. Otherwise [Fury of the Mountain] + ([Maul] for initial rage) [Furious Slam] for clearing.
SELECTING WEAPON SETS: configure in skill menu (G) — link Dual Specialisation guide.
## Act 2 (30 tree) attribute mix; Pick [Heat of the Forge] for more damage on bosses, but requires that you get into to level up [Living Bomb]. Otherwise pick [Smith's Masterwork] and the defence ones such as [Leather Bindings], [Flowing Metal], [Molten Symbol]

## Act 3 (32 equip) same priority list
## Act 3 (33 gems) For clear, [Ferocious Roar] into [Furious Slam] inside a big bunched pack. Level up [Ferocious Roar] to guarantee armour break for [Armour Explosion]. Replace [Armour Explosion] with [Aftershock I] in [Furious Slam] for bosses. [Forge Hammer] replaces [Volcanic Fissure].
## Act 3 (34 tree) attribute mix.

## Act 4+ (36 equip) same priority list
## Act 4+ (37 gems) [Rampage] replaces [Furious Slam] for all its uses. Use [Ferocious Roar] first to get rage and armour break for [Rampage].
## Act 4+ (38 tree) attribute mix.

## Endgame (48 equip) weapon: %inc phys/adds phys; adds fire; +melee; attack speed. Armour: MS boots; ele res; life; %armour; adds dmg to attacks / +melee.
- Set 1 Socketed with [Guatelitzi's Soul Core of Endurance] and [Thane Myrk's Rune of Summer]
- Ideally exceptional [Ornate Plate] with 3 sockets, or corrupted to 3 sockets
- Anoint/Instil on amulet: [Tides of Change] (but maybe save currency for better amulet first)
## Endgame (49 gems)
- Very important that [Ancestral Cry] ([Ferocious Roar]) has [Jagged Ground I] socketed, and [Walking Calamity] has [Rageforged I] socketed
- [Savage Fury] is ONLY active on set 2 ... still works like normal in set 1, but we don't pay its 30 spirit cost
- [Ancestral Cry] requires Glory, from igniting enemies. Needs 100 glory before it can activate via [Ferocious Roar]. Set to both sets: first select set 2 THEN set 1
- Get 6 [Endurance] charges and 100 glory before using [Ancestral Cry] ([Ferocious Roar])
- Charge up [Walking Calamity] initially by using [Maul] to gain rage and getting hit with [Ngamahu's Chosen]. Should only be required once per map
- Single target: [Infernal Cry] into [Forge Hammer], then trigger the Forge Hammer with [Ferocious Roar] (you don't need Ancestral Cry off CD/glory). Activate fissures by walking around with Ancestral Cry steps
- [Fury of the Mountain] for killing rares as Ancestral Cry will trigger its fissures. Don't spam, fissures don't stack
## Endgame (50 tree)
- Travel points mainly str but enough int for high level [Living Bomb] (some dex for supports early)
- PSA! Before taking [Self Immolation], you need [One With Flame] or you will DIE!
- [Primal Hunger] and [Blood Magic] should be first focused if underleveled.

## Uber Endgame (44 equip)
- Armour/jewelry: MS boots; Resistance (75% F/C/L, 30-50% Chaos); max life; %/+ armour, %/+ max ES; Stats (mainly str, need int for high level Living Bomb/Comet); +melee
- Set 1 [Fury of the King] with 5 Glory per 2 seconds. Perfect jewellers for 5 sockets in [Molten Crash] (+ Perfect Flux for level 20). [Guatelitzi's Soul Core of Endurance] and (blank)
- [Conjurer Mantle] should have enough spirit on the implicit to get 160 spirit at minimum. To get total 4 sockets, exceptional base with 3 sockets then corrupt
- [Goregirdle] can be corrupted with dexterity implicit to fit [Charge Regulation], otherwise +1 Endurance charge is good
- [Undying Hate (amanamu)]: tribute number doesn't matter, must say "...in tribute to amanamu" -> converts [Vaal Pact] keystone to Sacrifice of Flesh. If not corrupted, desecrate once safely for up to +8 attribute
- [Citaqualotl's Thesis] decent defence boost in boots, or [Farrul's Rune of the Chase] for speed
- [Ruby] jewels: desecrated prefix 10% increased max ES. [Sapphire]: desecrated 4-7% fire penetration
- Anoint/Instil on amulet: [Tides of Change] (or Jewel socket if GG amulet)
Alternatives: [Headhunter] belt for mapping; [Mageblood] quicksilver > granite; [Defiance of Destiny] recovery option over damage amulet; [Guatelitzi's Thesis] and/or [Farrul's Rune of the Chase] in boots ULTRA FAST
## Uber Endgame (45 gems)
- Get 6 Endurance charges and 100 glory before Ancestral Cry (Ferocious Roar)
- Place [Ancestral Warrior Totem] (need 3 Endurance) before a boss spawns to break armour
- [Molten Crash] replaces [Fury of the Mountain] (don't even need [Forge Hammer][Infernal Cry])
- [Savage Fury] ONLY active on set 2 ... don't pay 30 spirit
- Ferocious Roar (Ancestral Cry) active on BOTH sets
- Only add Level 14 [Charge Regulation] once you have 57 dex and 160 total spirit via implicit [Conjurer Mantle], or spirit amulet and [Soul Core of Azcapa] in [Fury of the King]
- Replace [Living Bomb] ([Overabundance II] & [Concentrated Area]) with [Detonate Dead] ([Magnified Area II] & [Spell Cascade]) for clear, or replace [Comet] in Cast on Elemental Ailment (OR both but don't use Spell Cascade and [Fiery Death])
- Corrupted +1 level Living Bomb and Comet: create low level, corrupt; then upgrade to 20 with another gem for 21; level it in normal skill bar, not in Fire Spell on Hit / CoEA
- Quality priority: Ancestral Cry, Walking Calamity, then rest
## Uber Endgame (46 tree)
- Travel points mainly str, enough int for high level Living Bomb (some dex for supports)
- PSA! Before [Self Immolation] need [One With Flame]
- Only take [Vaal Pact] once you get [Undying Hate (amanamu)]

## Uber Titan (54 equip)
- Weapon: %phys/adds phys; damage gained as extra fire; +melee. Armour: MS; Res (74% F/C/L, 50-75% chaos); +melee; life; armour; % of armour applies to elemental damage
- Set 1 Fury of the King 5 glory/2s, Perfect jewellers 5 sockets Molten Crash (+Perfect Flux lvl20). Guatelitzi's Soul Core of Endurance + Any ([Farrul's Rune of the Hunt] ok)
- [Omen Sceptre] needs [Lord of the Wilds] (ideally level 20 [Malice])
- Undying Hate (amanamu) note; "throw it into the abyss well once safely to get up to +8 attribute"
- Citaqualotl's Thesis / Farrul's Rune of the Chase in boots
- Anoint amulet Tides of Change
Alternatives: [Mageblood] diamond > quicksilver > granite; Headhunter; [Trampletoe] runeforged 5% extra MS; Defiance of Destiny; Guatelitzi's Thesis/Farrul's Rune of the Chase
## Uber Titan (55 gems)
- 6 endurance + 100 glory; Ancestral Warrior Totem before boss; [Infernal Cry] and [Elemental Weakness] bosses; Molten Crash replaces Fury of the Mountain; Savage Fury only set 2, don't pay its 60 spirit (need spirit from [Chober Chaber]); Ferocious Roar both sets; Second Ancestral Cry (not in Ferocious Roar) purely to track glory; quality priority Ancestral Cry, Walking Calamity
## Uber Titan (56 tree) YOU ARE A [Titan]; Ascendancy points: [Hulking Form], [Stone Skin], [Mysterious Lineage]. Str mainly, int for high level Elemental Weakness (18+). PSA Self Immolation/One With Flame. UNSPEC [Resolute Technique]! Only take Vaal Pact once you get Undying Hate (amanamu)

## ORPHAN widget 22 (gems): Build rage with Maul, Furious Slam 10+ rage; Infernal Cry after 30 rage then double Furious Slam; 2x Shockwave Totem on Jagged Ground
## ORPHAN widget 40 (gems): [Cast on Elemental Ailment] set 1 with [Eternal Rage] set 2 for meme gameplay, flashy Comet spamming boss dmg, beware mana cost; [Infernal Cry] twice at start of map (after moving to activate skill due to [Echoing Cry]) to generate rage with Eternal Rage and get glory for Walking Calamity; otherwise in Bear (Ancestral Cry active) use Maul and facetank to generate rage for Walking Calamity; mainly use [Fury of the Mountain] to quickly spend rage to gain Endurance for Ancestral Cry; get 5 Endurance before Ancestral Cry
## ORPHAN widget 42 (gems): Mainly use [Maul] to spend rage for Endurance; get 5 Endurance before Ancestral Cry
